slot: agent framework (TypeScript) - PRIMARY for the app stack

pick.name: Vercel AI SDK (ai 7.x)
pick.what: TS toolkit: unified model API, structured output, tool loop/agents, streaming UI hooks for React/Next/Node
pick.why: Fits the TS monorepo (React, Expo, Node), provider-agnostic (Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenRouter), most documented so Claude Code writes it reliably

alts.name: Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript)
alts.what: Claude Code's agent loop, tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, sessions as a library
alts.why: Best for coding/file/ops agents on Claude; covered by Max API credits
alts.free_limits: Covered by Max credits. Not allowed: offering claude.ai login or limits to your users - API key auth only
alts.license: Anthropic Commercial Terms (npm: 'SEE LICENSE IN README')

alts.name: Mastra
alts.what: TS agent framework: workflows, memory, RAG, evals, observability, MCP authoring
alts.why: Batteries-included if you want one TS framework with workflow graphs and HITL
alts.license: Apache-2.0 core; ee/ dirs under source-available Mastra Enterprise License (prod use needs licence)

candidates.name: Vercel AI SDK
candidates.verdict: Pick: ubiquitous, typed, UI hooks, provider-agnostic

candidates.name: Claude Agent SDK (TS)
candidates.verdict: Alt: strongest agentic tool use, Claude-only, pre-1.0, subprocess runtime

candidates.name: Mastra
candidates.verdict: Alt: full framework, ee licence carve-out

decision: AI SDK is the default for product agents in the TS monorepo: one API across web, Expo and Node and Claude Code knows it well. Add the Claude Agent SDK for heavy tool-using agents billed to Max credits; reach for Mastra/LangGraph.js only for durable multi-step workflows with suspend/resume.
details: TS is primary for the app stack; Python pick is next item. Agent SDK needs the Claude Code binary - fine on a server, awkward in Expo.

verify.note: Version/licence/limits match registry or official page.
